# mevspace_dedicated_server (Resource)

Manages an existing (already ordered) MEVSpace dedicated server: OS install and power state. The API cannot order or cancel servers, so destroying this resource only removes it from state. Setting or changing template_id, raid_value, startup_script_id or reinstall_triggers REINSTALLS the server and wipes its disks; plans that would do so fail unless allow_reinstall = true.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mevspace_templates" "dedicated" {
  type = "dedicated"
}

locals {
  debian13 = one([for t in data.mevspace_templates.dedicated.items : t.id if t.name == "Debian 13"])
}

# Adopt an already ordered server without touching it.
resource "mevspace_dedicated_server" "db" {
  hostname = "srv11111.mevnode.com"
}

# Install an OS. Any plan that would reinstall (and WIPE) the server
# fails unless allow_reinstall = true.
resource "mevspace_dedicated_server" "web" {
  hostname        = "srv12345.mevnode.com"
  template_id     = local.debian13
  raid_value      = "1"
  allow_reinstall = true
  power_state     = "running"

  reinstall_triggers = {
    version = "1"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `hostname` (String) Hostname of the dedicated server, as shown in the MEVSpace panel.

### Optional

- `allow_reinstall` (Boolean) Must be true for any plan that reinstalls (wipes) the server. Defaults to false.
- `power_state` (String) Desired power state: running or stopped. Applied on create and when changed; not read back from the API.
- `raid_value` (String) RAID type used on reinstall. Requires template_id.
- `reinstall_triggers` (Map of String) Arbitrary values; any change triggers a reinstall. Requires template_id.
- `startup_script_id` (Number) Startup script id (see mevspace_startup_scripts) run after reinstall. Requires template_id.
- `template_id` (Number) OS template id (see mevspace_templates). When set, the server is reinstalled on create and whenever install settings change.

### Read-Only

- `attributes` (Map of String) All fields returned by the API for this server, as strings.
- `id` (String) Same as hostname.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import mevspace_dedicated_server.web srv12345.mevnode.com
```
